title: PriceProtectExecLineItem - Data API
description: Represents a line item created as part of a Price Protection Execution. This object is available in API version 63.0 and later.

AccountId.description: References the partner account related to the transaction being evaluated for price protection. This field is a relationship field.

CalculatedAmount.description: Total protected amount calculated based on the applicable price difference and quantity.

CalculationReferenceRecordId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CalculationReferenceRecordId.description: References the rebate or pricing rule used to compute the claim. This field is a relationship field.

ClaimReferenceId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ClaimReferenceId.description: Links to the related rebate claim, if one has been generated. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

HasWarnings.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
HasWarnings.description: Indicates if the execution line item has associated warnings. The default value is false.

InTransitQuantity.description: Quantity of the product in transit.

IsEligible.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsEligible.description: Indicates whether the record qualifies for price protection. The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the record was last referenced by a user or system.

LastViewedDate.description: Date and timestamp when the record was last opened in the UI.

LocationId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LocationId.description: References the inventory or sales location relevant to the line item. This field is a relationship field.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: Auto-generated identifier for the line item record.

NewSalePricePerUnit.description: The new sale price per unit after the price change.

NewSalePriceType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
NewSalePriceType.description: Type of sale price applied post-adjustment (e.g., List Price, Net Price).

PriceDifference.description: Difference between the old and new sale price per unit. This field is a calculated field.

PriceProtectionExecutionId.description: Links to the parent Price Protection Execution record. This field is a relationship field.

PriceProtectionTermId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PriceProtectionTermId.description: References the Price Protection Term used for evaluating eligibility and calculations. This field is a relationship field.

ProductId.description: References the product involved in the price protection claim. This field is a relationship field.

RemainingQuantity.description: Quantity of product still eligible for claim after partial adjustments.

SalePricePerUnit.description: Original sale price per unit before the price adjustment.

SalePriceType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SalePriceType.description: Type of sale price recorded during the original transaction.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: Current processing state of the line item. Possible values are: Complete Error New ReadyForClaim—Ready For Claim ReadyForPricing—Ready For Pricing ReadyForSimulation—Ready For Simulation

StatusReason.description: Additional explanation or message associated with the current status.

TransactionDate.description: Date when the original sale or transaction occurred.

TransactionReferenceId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TransactionReferenceId.description: Reference to the transaction record from which this line item originates. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

WarningMessage.description: Descriptive warning associated with this line item, if applicable.
